purpose: Preserve in-memory read-view controls across browser tab revalidation while requiring fresh authorized data and exact session/read-scope continuity; preserve existing visual design.

dependencies.state: Provisional; shared proxy/test/workflow paths require explicit author handoff and root composition, never overwrite from old base.

constraints: Only browser hidden/visible/focus continuity; no visual redesign, persistent row/control storage or unrelated module-switch feature. Mask protected data while authority unavailable; refresh before redisplay.

Stable opaque noncredential server-session and read-scope markers in response headers only; domain-separated token-bound digest or protected mechanism, never token/credential/identity disclosure. Markers never authorize requests; existing cookie/CSRF/native rights unchanged.

Do not use authorityVersion observation sequence, expiry or display name as identity. Canonical scope sets; confirmed retirement, account/session or rights change clears view state. Fresh response generations reject late canceled/stale data.

Retain memory-only selection/filter/pages/scroll for same verified session/scope; reconcile selection against authorized fresh data before detail display. Read failures hide data without claiming logout or losing controls prematurely.

Header markers on workspace/document responses must reflect the response session/scope; validate/relay only named bounded headers in BFF. No public JSON contract changes, SQL, configuration or business-write activation.

Actual composed Workspace/browser regression and backend marker tests required for healthy version/expiry/set-order changes, outages, revoke/account swap and stale responses. Existing I20/I21/I24 and QR suites preserved.
Root alone publishes/integrates; I28 shared-path custody handoff mandatory. No missing tests/skips claimed pass. Independent privacy/security review plus exact-head/current-base CI before merge.
